items.myth: Abroad mein sirf CS ka scope hai
items.fact: Har field ke achhe courses hain
items.detail: Business, design, health, public policy. Apni interest aur profile se chuno.

items.myth: Bade city mein hi padhna chahiye
items.detail: Chhote city mein bhi achhe campus hote hain. Kharcha aur lifestyle bhi dekho.

items.myth: Course ka naam dekh ke chuno
items.detail: Same naam, alag subjects. Modules, projects aur internships check karo.
